title: trachyspermum matthewii
intro: Trachyspermum matthewii, commonly known as Ajwain, is a plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family. It is native to India and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and culinary purposes. The health benefits of Ajwain include its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Ajwain include compounds like thymol, carvone, and limonene, which exhibit therapeutic actions including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
